import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int num_x = scanner.nextInt();
        int num_y = scanner.nextInt();
        int max_iter = scanner.nextInt();

        final double LARGE_NUM = 99999999.0;
        double min_error = LARGE_NUM;
        int best_num = 0;
        int best_den = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= max_iter; ++i) {
            int candidate_num = (int) Math.round(1.0 * num_x * i / num_y - 0.0000001);
            double error = Math.abs((1.0 * num_x / num_y) - (1.0 * candidate_num / i));
            if (error < min_error) {
                best_num = candidate_num;
                best_den = i;
                min_error = error;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(best_num + "/" + best_den);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
